title.en: One useful thought. Worth coming back to.

summary.en: Find a Builder Note about slow iteration — and a quieter way to work with AI.
summary.zh: 从 Builder Notes 找到“慢慢迭代”：AI 也能让人从容地打磨喜欢的事。

outline.en: Find the public Builder Notes archive. Open AI Taught Me a Phrase: Slow Iteration. Read the thought and inspect its illustration, then return to the archive.
outline.zh: 从 Builder Notes 打开 Slow Iteration，关注小游戏与写小说这两个具体例子，再看插画如何表达“慢慢搭起一个世界”。最后返回列表。整个过程无需账号。

title.zh: 两张发票，一次有依据的决定。

summary.en: Fix the missing coding. Check two invoices and $2,000. Then verify the approved batch after a reload.
summary.zh: 补全分类，核对两张发票与 $2,000 总额，刷新后再次确认审批结果。

outline.en: In a fictional signed-in review workspace, assign the invoice category and leave a reason. Select the two intended invoices. Confirm the count and $2,000 total before the simulated approval. Reload the saved batch and verify its count, total and Approved status.
outline.zh: 在虚构的登录后工作台补全发票分类与审核说明，选择指定的两张发票。模拟审批前核对数量和 $2,000 总额；刷新保存的批次后，再次确认数量、总额与 Approved 状态。
